mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 530000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher interest rates increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO levels fail to predict positive 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.02) over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 260, it indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) signals robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST > 1400 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 142,000 jobs, it indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 142000 over any 1-year rolling window.
